info.name: Local Crop Disease Detector API
info.description:
# 🌱 Crop Disease Detector & Agricultural Advisory API

RESTful backend service for farmer accounts, leaf disease diagnosis via ONNX deep-learning microservice, preventive agricultural guidance, and user prediction history.

### 📌 Environments
- **Local Server**: `http://localhost:8080`
- **Production Render Server**: `https://crop-backend-r14q.onrender.com`
- **Live ML Microservice**: `https://gdg-grp-task-ml-2.onrender.com`

### 🔐 Authentication Strategy
Authenticated endpoints require a standard Bearer JWT token in the `Authorization` header:
```http
Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}
```
When you run the **Register** or **Login** requests in this collection, Postman's built-in test script will **automatically save** the JWT token into your environment variable `{{accessToken}}`.

### 🍃 Supported Crops
- **Tomato** (*Solanum lycopersicum*)
- **Potato** (*Solanum tuberosum*)
- **Apple** (*Malus domestica*)
- **Corn** (*Zea mays*)
- **Pepper, Grape, Orange, Peach, Cherry, Blueberry, Raspberry, Squash, Strawberry, Soybean*

### ⚠️ Photo Guidelines for Prediction
- Max image file size: **5 MB**
- Formats: JPEG (`.jpg`, `.jpeg`), PNG (`.png`), WebP
- Confidence guardrail: If confidence < 0.70, prediction status is marked `UNCERTAIN`.

item.name: 2. Leaf Disease Diagnosis & Predictions
item.description: Core computer vision endpoints for diagnosing plant diseases from leaf photographs, receiving preventative management guidance, and tracking diagnosis history.

formdata.description: Leaf photo file (JPEG / PNG / WebP, max 5MB)
Optional crop hint (e.g. tomato, potato, apple, corn, pepper)

request.description:
### Direct Leaf Diagnosis Endpoint
- **Route:** `POST /api/crops/diagnose` (also available at `/api/v1/crops/diagnose`)
- **Public Access:** Fully accessible for web / mobile clients without requiring login.
- **Authentication Support:** If an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is present, the diagnosis is automatically saved to the farmer's history.

### Form Data Parameters
- `image` (binary file, required): Photo of crop leaf
- `crop` (text, optional): Crop name hint (e.g., `tomato`, `potato`, `apple`, `pepper`, `corn`)

### Response Highlights
- `prediction.crop`: Identified crop species
- `prediction.disease`: Identified pathogen or health status
- `prediction.confidence`: Confidence level (0.0 to 1.0)
- `top_k`: List of top alternative classifications with respective scores
- `low_confidence`: Boolean flag indicating if confidence is below safety threshold
- `disclaimer`: Official agricultural advisory disclaimer

response.name: 200 OK - Diagnosis Complete (High Confidence)

formdata.description: Leaf image file (JPEG or PNG, max 5MB)
Optional crop identifier (e.g., tomato, potato, apple, corn)

request.description:
Submits a leaf image to generate a prediction with non-prescriptive, farmer-friendly management guidance.

### Authentication
- **Optional Bearer Token:** If provided, prediction is linked to the user account.
- **Anonymous:** Permitted for guest users.

### Image Constraints
- Max file size: **5 MB**
- Max resolution: **6000 x 6000 px** (20 Megapixels)
- Allowed formats: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`

### Response Guardrails
- If `confidence < 0.70`, status becomes `UNCERTAIN` and advisory alerts are added to `guidance`.

response.body:

item.name: 4. User Profile & Preferences
item.description: Endpoints to manage the logged-in farmer's account details, localization (language English / Hindi), and notification preferences.

request.description:
Retrieves the currently authenticated user's profile information.

### Authentication
- **Requires Bearer Token:** `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`

Updates profile details for the authenticated user.

### Request Body
- `fullName` (string, required): New full name (max 100 chars)
Fetches current farmer preferences including UI localization language and notification alerts.

Updates language and notification settings.

### Request Body
- `language` (string): Language code, e.g., `"en"` (English) or `"hi"` (Hindi)
- `notificationsEnabled` (boolean): In-app push notification alerts
- `emailUpdatesEnabled` (boolean): Email alerts for crop reports
